QuestInfo.name: Explorer Lv. 40 Challenge
QuestInfo.0: What kind of gift will be waiting if you reach Lv. 40 with an Explorer character?
QuestInfo.1: Reach Lv. 40 and receive the #bHonorable Explorer#k title.
QuestInfo.2: You achieved Lv. 40 and received the #b<Honorable Explorer>#k title.

0.0: Now, you're ready for Lv. 40. Keep in mind that you have to perform your 2nd job advancement to become even stronger. The various Explorer skills that have been strengthened through this patch will apply after the 2nd job advancement, so you should be able to reach Lv. 40 in no time.

yes.0: Come back to me after reaching Lv. 40 and I'll give you the #b<Honorable Explorer>#k title.

no.0: Are you serious? Come back to me if you change your mind.

1.0: Nice! You've reached Lv. 40. I'll give you the #b<Honorable Explorer>#k title as I've promised.

yes.0: You're really starting to look like a veteran Explorer. Good job thus far!

default.0: You haven't reached Lv. 40 yet. Keep trying and you'll get there!

item.0: Hmm... It looks like you already have one of the Explorer Rings. Unfortunately, you won't be able to participate in this event.
